name: @cloudcare/guance-electron-workspace
description: Build workspace for Guance Electron Adapter and macOS Full Mode packages

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @cloudcare/guance-electron-adapter && npm run build --workspace @cloudcare/guance-electron-macos
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test --workspace @cloudcare/guance-electron-adapter && npm run test --workspace @cloudcare/guance-electron-macos
scripts.test:native-addon: npm run build --workspace @cloudcare/guance-electron-adapter && npm run test:native-addon --workspace @cloudcare/guance-electron-macos
scripts.pack: npm run build && npm run verify && node scripts/pack-packages.mjs
scripts.release: npm run build:native:universal && npm test && npm run pack
